why: The walk `neighbors` cannot express. `neighbors` chains outbound and inbound edges unconditionally and filters on neither relationship nor direction, so a server offering only that has typed its graph and left no way to walk by the types. `enables` is authored once in this corpus, from `knowledge-graph` to `traversal`, and `relates-to` is authored twice — a server ignoring the relationship name answers three nodes here, and a server ignoring direction answers the wrong one.
